======================================================================
Fling P2P File Transfer - Sample Test Document
======================================================================

Project: Fling CLI
Protocol: Reliable UDP (Stop-and-Wait ARQ)
Chunk Size: 1024 Bytes
Integrity: IEEE 802.3 CRC32 Checksum

This sample file is designed for testing peer-to-peer file transfers
across local area networks (LANs). When transferring this file:

1. Handshake consent negotiation is triggered on the destination node.
2. The payload is split into fixed 1024-byte chunks.
3. Chunks are transmitted, ACKed, and reordered asynchronously.
4. The full reconstructed file is validated using CRC32 checksums.
5. The received file is saved to disk and can be revealed in Finder.

Testing complete: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog!
======================================================================
